mapper.select:
SELECT u.id AS id, u.username AS username, u.real_name AS realName, u.phone AS phone, r.gender AS gender, r.birth_year AS birthYear, r.occupation AS occupation, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assessment a WHERE a.resident_id = u.id) AS assessmentCount, (SELECT MAX(a.created_at) FROM assessment a WHERE a.resident_id = u.id) AS lastAssessmentAt, (SELECT a.risk_level FROM assessment a WHERE a.resident_id = u.id ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastRiskLevel, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assessment a WHERE a.resident_id = u.id AND a.crisis_flag = 1) AS crisisCount,
(SELECT cs.id FROM consult_session cs WHERE cs.resident_id = u.id AND cs.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND cs.consult_type = 'DOCTOR' AND cs.status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY cs.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS sessionId FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN `user` r ON r.id = u.id
u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.role = 'RESIDENT'
AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY lastAssessmentAt DESC, u.id
